## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**DNA fingerprinting** — Using unique DNA patterns to identify individuals
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**STR analysis** — Short Tandem Repeats - variable regions used for identification
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Chain of custody** — The documented handling of evidence to ensure validity
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Database matching** — Comparing crime scene DNA to a database of profiles
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Mitochondrial DNA** — DNA from mitochondria, useful when nuclear DNA is degraded
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**CODIS** — Combined DNA Index System - database for law enforcement
:::
